name: Scholarship Scheme of Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram
benefit:
***Benefit Component:*** School Fee, Dietary Charge, Clothing Money (New/Subsequent Year) ***Parent Income Category (per month):*** Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe: Up to ₹50,000/- OR General Category: Up to ₹25,000/- ***Benefit Rate:*** Rate I (Full) ***State Government's Share:*** 100% of Fee/Charge + ₹2,000/- (For Fee only) ***Central Share:*** NIL
***Benefit Component:*** School Fee,
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should belong to Mizoram State only. - The applicant must qualify in the Annual Entrance examination conducted by the All India Sainik School Society. - The applicant must be admitted to Sainik School Chhingchhip, Mizoram. - The applicant must not be covered under any other Scholarship scheme. - The applicant must submit Income certificates/salary certificates at the time of admission for the grant of scholarship. - For Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST): The income of the parent/guardian should not exceed ₹1,00,000/- (One lakh) per month. - For General Category: The income of the parent/guardian should not exceed ₹50,000/- (Fifty Thousand) per month. - The applicant must not be more than one child of the same parents’/guardians eligible for the said scheme. _*The scholarship will be discontinued if the cadet is found medically unfit for entry into the National Defence Academy._ _*The scholarship will be cancelled and the amount recovered if the student is found to have obtained the scholarship by false statements, and the student will be blacklisted forever._ _*The student is liable to refund the scholarship amount if they discontinue the studies for which the scholarship was awarded during the course of the year._
